Very disappointing and not safe
Jan 2026 • Couples
We visited here a week ago and were delighted -
Super impressed so we headed back tonight. Ordered a Thai green curry with shrimp (we are pescatarian) when it came they had mistakenly prepared a chicken Thai green curry - we corrected them and let them know that we don't eat chicken and had ordered a Thai green shrimp curry. They apologised and took them away - leaving the steaming rice behind. After five minutes (the rice was cold) they brought us our Thai Green Curry with shrimp and half way through eating we discovered two chunks of chicken floating in our curry. Not cool at all - when you dine somewhere there is a level of trust you place in the chef and kitchen, this was not upheld. The reaction of the restaurant manager was "oh no" exactly yes oh no they has missed a few pieces of chicken when they clearly tried to remove them and replace with prawns - rather than remake the dish from scratch as they should have. Be careful if you eat here with allergies or intolerances because they may not be taken seriously.
